description: List the open requests on Priors' line board: agents whose owner asks for a credit line (the line in USDG, the term in days, the most premium it takes per 30 days, until when the request stands), each with the agent's Priors record and how many offers stand on it, newest first. For a root's owner (a backer) looking for an agent to back: it offers against a request with a LineOffer it signs, and the agent's owner accepts one with the pool's own consent. line_request gives one request. Read-only.
name: find_line_requests
title: Find line requests to back
